_meta.fields:
v    V0, the LIGSITE pocket volume (A^3) at the predicted site in the structure the row was scored from, ligand removed (the MD readout's own measure)
  o    1 when a drug-like ligand already sits at the site in that structure (>= 30 % of the pocket residues in contact): a known ligand site, nothing to open
  lf   the share of pocket residues in contact with a ligand there
  v5   the same volume at a relaxed LIGSITE setting (latent cavity); only for closed band 3+ rows with no ligand-bound entry of the protein, and the cancer rows
  ev   what OTHER structures of the same protein show at the site, ligand removed: V validated (an inhibitor-like ligand touches the site and a cavity of >= 40 A^3 forms, mostly absent in ours),
       N native only (the cavity forms around a cofactor, nucleotide, substrate or sugar: an induced fit), P pre-formed, S shallow (no enclosed cavity: a flat groove), 0 no ligand-bound entry found;
       absent = not checked (it was run for closed band 3+ rows, partly formed band 3+ rows and the cancer rows, never for a row that already holds a ligand)
  nh na  ligand-bound entries and entries without a ligand at the site that were read (a fixed random subset of up to 6)
  v1   median site volume in the ligand-bound entries; lg the ligands that touch the site (>= 3 residues); fg 1 when one of them is not native-like
  len  UniProt sequence length (coverage = residues in the row's structure / len)
  dz sm role  top diseases [name, score, genetic], Open Targets small-molecule bucket and Cancer Gene Census role, for the proteins left by the two gates (post_screen.py)
  af   the LIGSITE volume of the ALPHAFOLD model at the same residues, with the model CUT to the residues the row's structure holds (a row whose structure is the model itself needs no cut); closed rows only (post_screen.py,
       code/md/af_cut_volume.py). On the 172 closed band 3+ rows with a ligand-bound entry of the same protein a cavity later formed at 62 % of the sites where it reads 40 A^3 or more against 22 % where it reads less (AUROC 0.78;
       the whole-protein model gave AUROC 0.82; relaxed volume alone 0.74; af_openability.py and af_cut_volume.py)
  afw  the same volume on the WHOLE AlphaFold model, for rows whose structure is one part of the protein (it is larger when residues the structure lacks enclose the site; FAM111A 458 whole, 25 cut)
  afc  the cell of that table for rows with nothing to check against: hh AlphaFold 40+ and latent cavity 120+ (65 % formed a cavity), hl AlphaFold only (54 %), lh latent only (40 %), ll neither (10 %)
  lit  [PubMed records naming the gene with a cancer term, with Alzheimer's] for the rows of the corrected screen (pubmed_counts.py): a crude second look at the disease link that Open Targets' top lists missed for PBK and HSD17B10; a symbol that is also a word or an antibody name inflates it
  pts  the transparent priority points of post_screen.py (evidence tier, cavity evidence, disease, chemistry, label-clean, size, not nucleic-acid machinery, fragment penalty), with the cavity points of a hypothesis row taken from the cut AlphaFold volume; a sort key, not a measurement
